card.name: Small words in biographical sketches
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, at, of or a colon inside short biographies of scholars. They come right after born, studies, educated, son, or a journal volume.

modes.label: Birth and origin
modes.description: The word in or of after born or the son, giving birthplace or parentage.
modes.example: Hilary Whitehall Putnam was born<< in>> Chicago in 1926.

modes.label: Education
modes.description: The word at or of after studies or educated, before a university name.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A colon between volume and page in a journal reference.
